mapper.select: select c.*, u.username from sys_user_passkey_credential c join sys_user u on u.id = c.user_id and u.deleted = 0 where c.credential_id = #{credentialId} and c.deleted = 0 limit 1

select c.*, u.username from sys_user_passkey_credential c join sys_user u on u.id = c.user_id and u.deleted = 0 where c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and c.user_id = #{userId} and c.deleted = 0 order by c.last_used_at desc, c.created_at desc, c.id desc
